fixtureCoverage.note: Physical emitter distance and conservative support of the new bounded fields; excludes existing source lights and emissive windows. Points inside a field are not guaranteed to be perceptually bright.

windowMetadata.selection: Deterministic manifest order; 2–3 of 8 windows per new house, at least one front and one rear window each, selected additional front/side windows.
windowMetadata.existingCurtains: New-house linen remains physically in front of the light sheet; old procedural linen margins are exposed by clipping the added sheet.
windowMetadata.preserved: All original geometry, panes, frames, curtains and closed backboards. Existing warm source materials are cloned; no PointLight or interior rooms.

lampMetadata.limitations: The broad field is bounded diffuse fill, not shadowed global illumination. Local point lights have short falloff and no new shadow maps.
